_comment: Pipeline registry for generate_image / edit_image / stylize_image. tools.py runs each call against the resident ComfyUI's active_model (Manager.capabilities()['image']), gated on that model's declared `capabilities` verb list; there is no user/LLM model selection and no coding/chat mode. Each key maps a tool to an API-format graph in this directory plus a `nodes` map of logical role -> node id; tools.py patches by role via workflows.set_node (which picks the right input key from each node's class_type), so a ComfyUI 'Export (API)' re-save that renumbers nodes only needs the ids here updated. `prompt_rewrite` points at a prompts/*.txt system prompt used by prompt_llm.rewrite(). An `edit` tool with `inpaint: "builtin"` also carries `inpaint_graph` -- a CLIPSeg-segment + masked-inpaint graph (workflows.load_inpaint_graph); those graphs MUST keep the klein MASK_* node-id layout because tools.py._submit_edit rewires those ids directly, differing only in the model front-end (loaders / guidance). `validated: false` = derived from a community template, not yet run against this install (it still executes; the flag is surfaced in the tool's reply). Roles: positive/prompt (text), width, height, seed, image, denoise, scale_by, save.

flux2-klein.label: Flux.2 Klein 9B -- fast distilled, 4-step, the default

flux2-dev-turbo.label: Flux.2 dev -- fp8 base + fal FLUX.2-dev-Turbo LoRA, 8-step; eGPU, chat mode only (generate + stylize)

tools._edit_note: Masked-only path (server.py routes target_region + chat mode here). Graph tuned 2026-09: FluxGuidance 5.5; ColorMatchV2 (node 26) BYPASSED -- ImageCompositeMasked source = raw VAEDecode (node 25) -- because it threw a teal cast + magenta halo on any real colour change, so color_correct_strength is a no-op here (still honoured by the klein graph). preserve_scene_context works normally: default keeps the full-image ReferenceLatent (node 23) for surface edits (recolour/restyle); _submit_edit rewires KSampler.positive to the masked-region ReferenceLatent (node 22) and drops 21/23 when the caller passes preserve_scene_context=False for a genuine identity swap (car->pickup). Keeps every klein MASK_* node id so server._submit_edit patches it unchanged.

ideogram4.label: Ideogram 4 -- 9.3B DiT (Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder, dual-model guider); strong at typography / text-in-image. generate only, cuda only.
